input: Renew the car registration before the deadline

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the exact deadline determines how urgent the plan is and whether there is time for mail-in or slower methods.
The state or country governs the specific steps, fees, required documents, and available renewal channels.
Some renewals require a smog/emissions test or safety inspection first, which adds separate subtasks and lead time.
Whether the user plans to renew online, by mail, or in person at the DMV changes every step of the process.
If the vehicle is under someone else's name or a lien holder is involved, additional authorisation or coordination steps are needed.
Knowing whether they already have the renewal notice or need to locate account details shapes the very first action.
Clarifying whether they need just the sticker on the plate or also a paper registration card in hand affects when the task is truly done.

gold.taskTitle: Renew car registration before the deadline
gold.taskDescription: Complete the car registration renewal process in full before the expiry date to stay legally compliant.

questions.title: When exactly does your registration expire?
questions.description: Identify the exact expiry date to calibrate urgency and rule out or include slower renewal methods.

questions.title: Which state or country is the vehicle registered in?
questions.description: Determine the jurisdiction to apply the correct steps, fees, and document requirements.

questions.title: Does your vehicle need a smog or safety inspection first?
questions.description: Establish whether a pre-renewal inspection is required, which adds lead time and a separate step.

questions.title: Do you plan to renew online, by mail, or in person?
questions.description: Identify the preferred renewal channel, as each has a completely different set of actions.

questions.title: Is the vehicle registered solely in your name?
questions.description: Determine if a co-owner, lien holder, or another party must be involved in the renewal process.

questions.title: Do you already have your renewal notice or account details handy?
questions.description: Find out if the user has the notice with their renewal ID, which is needed to start the process.

questions.title: What does completion look like — sticker received and displayed on plate?
questions.description: Confirm what the user considers the task fully done, such as having the new sticker affixed or also holding a registration card.
